implement.extraPrompt: Notes for other Tickets (interim, until the pipeline routes them itself): if you discover something that belongs to another Ticket, or to no Ticket yet, do not act on it here. Before you finish, post it as a comment on the Ticket it belongs to with `gh issue comment <n>`, or open a new issue with `gh issue create --label needs-triage` when none fits. Start the note with `From #<this ticket> implement`. Write notes as plain sentences with no checkboxes.
